public_program: enclosed entrance vestibule with outer and inner doors
four general-merchandise aisle runs with cross aisles
staff_program: controlled sales-floor doors into the back corridor
receiving room connected to the loading dock
circulation: parking and sidewalk to outer vestibule doors
vestibule through inner doors to a broad sales-floor entry spine
entry spine to checkout lanes, departments, aisles and public restroom
sales floor through three controlled doors to the back corridor
back corridor to receiving, stockroom and staff-management rooms
staff-management room to independent rear exit
damage_constraints: preserve the entrance vestibule and a readable route into the sales floor
retain at least two cross aisles and one path to the public restroom
keep at least one sales-to-back-of-house route and the staff rear exit
concentrate structural failure in one rear department rather than scattering holes
shape rubble under gravity and expose the source wall or roof members
derive all abandoned variants from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the building reads as a supermarket from the road
customer and delivery approaches are distinct
retail departments and checkout circulation remain navigable
back-of-house rooms have credible adjacencies and independent exits
roof and facade have believable commercial construction
damage preserves the original building function
